description: Estimate what a GPU job will cost in CAD: hourly rate and projected total for the duration, on-demand by default or spot when the workload can checkpoint. Use when the user asks what something would cost. Read-only and free — it estimates only. If you are about to launch, call should_i_run_this instead, which also checks the balance.

spot.description: Price as interruptible spot capacity instead of on-demand. Materially cheaper, but the instance can be reclaimed — only use for workloads that checkpoint.

name: estimate_job_cost
